title: Multimodal CT-pathology imaging deep learning model for risk stratification in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma

summary: 基于多中心1078例患者，融合术前CT与术后WSI的深度学习模型预测I期肺腺癌无病生存，优于单模态，并在验证队列中分层有效。

abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma is a highly heterogeneous disease, highlighting the need for more accurate prognosis prediction. We developed a multimodal deep learning model combining preoperative computed tomography (CT) and postoperative whole slide image (WSI) to predict the disease-free survival (DFS) of resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma. Based on a cohort of 1078 patients from multiple centers, our dual-information instance neural network achieved superior performance over unimodal approaches. The risk stratification defined by the model effectively distinguished DFS in both validation cohorts and served as an independent predictor, suggesting the complementary value of the model beyond clinicopathological factors. An exploratory scoring system integrating the model-derived risk stratification with key clinicopathological factors was developed, identifying patients with significantly different prognostic outcomes. Further analyses suggested that patients with high-risk stage IB disease or high scores might derive DFS benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation. Beyond its predictive capacity, the model also provided morphological insights, identifying prognostically significant structures such as tertiary lymphoid structures and stroma barriers, while RNA-sequencing analysis revealed distinct oncogenic pathway activation and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments in high-risk patients. By leveraging routinely acquired clinical images, this multimodal approach offers a practical tool for improving prognostic stratification, with potential implications for informing patient selection for adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌是一种高度异质性的疾病，因此需要更准确的预后预测。我们开发了一种多模态深度学习模型，结合术前计算机断层扫描（CT）和术后全切片图像（WSI），用于预测已切除的 I 期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。基于来自多个中心的 1078 例患者队列，我们的双信息实例神经网络（dual-information instance neural network）的表现优于单模态方法。该模型所定义的风险分层在两个验证队列中均能有效区分 DFS，并且是独立的预测因子，提示该模型在临床病理因素之外具有互补价值。我们还开发了一个探索性评分系统，将模型得出的风险分层与关键临床病理因素相结合，可识别出预后结局显著不同的患者。进一步分析提示，高风险 IB 期患者或高评分患者可能从辅助化疗中获得 DFS 获益，这有待前瞻性验证。除预测能力外，该模型还提供了形态学方面的见解，识别出具有预后意义的结构，如三级淋巴结构和间质屏障；同时 RNA 测序分析显示，高风险患者存在独特的致癌通路激活和免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境。通过利用常规获取的临床影像，这种多模态方法为改善预后分层提供了一种实用工具，并可能为已切除 I 期肺腺癌患者辅助化疗的选择提供参考。

title: Health-state instability and progression in longitudinal clinical records reveal heterogeneous ageing trajectories
zh_title: 纵向临床记录中的健康状态不稳定性揭示异质性衰老轨迹
summary: VitaFlux以下次就诊预测将就诊编码为潜在健康状态，在浙江人群队列17.9万人、444万次就诊上学习，预测不稳定性与1年、3年死亡率相关。
key_points: 预测不稳定性与1、3年死亡率相关

reason: 大规模纵向队列、患者级表征，含队列适应验证，上调
abstract: Longitudinal clinical records capture health changes, but most models reduce them to endpoint risks or single-time biological-age estimates. We developed VitaFlux, a representation-learning framework that uses next-visit forecasting to encode clinical encounters as latent health states. Applied to 178,970 individuals with 4,439,390 aligned visits from the Zhejiang Population Health Cohort, VitaFlux learned a reproducible representation organized by age-associated, disease-burden and multisystem physiological variation. Forecast instability measured predicted health-state change at the next visit and was associated with observed one- and three-year mortality. Continuous trajectory measures captured heterogeneous progression, while current and forecast states improved the prediction of multiple clinical outcomes compared with a comprehensive clinical baseline. After cohort-specific adaptation, future-state forecasting outperformed a no-change persistence baseline in two independent aging cohorts. VitaFlux provides a unified framework for representing health-state position, forecasting near-term dynamics and quantifying longer-term progression from longitudinal clinical records.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床记录捕捉了健康变化，但大多数模型将其简化为终点风险或单时间点的生物学年龄估计。我们开发了VitaFlux，一种表征学习框架，利用下一次就诊预测将临床就诊编码为潜在健康状态。将VitaFlux应用于浙江人群健康队列中178,970名个体、共4,439,390次对齐就诊，其学习到了一种可重复的表征，该表征按年龄相关、疾病负担和多系统生理变异进行组织。预测不稳定性衡量下一次就诊时预测的健康状态变化，并与观察到的1年和3年死亡率相关。连续轨迹指标捕捉了异质性的进展，而与综合临床基线相比，当前状态和预测状态改善了多种临床结局的预测。经队列特异性适配后，未来状态预测在两个独立的老龄化队列中优于无变化持续性基线。VitaFlux提供了一个统一框架，用于从纵向临床记录中表征健康状态位置、预测近期动态并量化长期进展。

title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions

abstract: Pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are prevalent and potential precursors of pancreatic cancer. Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. The model was developed and tested in a 13-year retrospective cohort comprising 23,398 abdominal CT/MRI examination reports from 8707 patients with PCLs across a multisite healthcare system. Of these, 430 (1.8%) corresponded to patients who later developed pancreatic cancer, defined as adenocarcinoma, invasive mucinous neoplasm, or high-grade dysplasia. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively. The model outperformed guideline-based risk stratification, with AUC improvements of 0.161 to 0.235 (P < 0.001). For examinations conducted within a year before cancer diagnosis, radiologists identified potential cancer in 51.5% of cases, while the AI model flagged 82.3%. These findings support the potential of AI to complement existing approaches for individualized pancreatic cancer risk stratification in patients with PCLs.

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Accurately predicting absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties remains a major challenge in accelerating drug discovery, especially for underexplored natural products (NPs). Herein, we present a unified multitask learning framework that integrated heterogeneous network (HN) embeddings and a modified kernel-based deep neural network (DNN) to simultaneously predict all ADMET properties. Our model named as hdADMET captures complex molecular interactions through HNs that incorporated compound-drug relationships, experimental validated ADMET features, and the interrelationships among ADMET properties to transform the embedding representations into a kernel-based DNN for boosting the learning ability of the prediction model. Hold-out cross-validation on benchmark data sets, including ChEMBL, BindingDB, CTRPandGDSC, and NPASS, demonstrated improved and robust accuracy through data integration. Compared with the state-of-the-art multitask models, the hdADMET model achieved competitive performance with a significantly lower computational cost. Its practical utility was further demonstrated by accurately predicting the ADMET profiles of newly identified NPs mined from the literature studies. The promising candidate with high anticancer activity, low toxicity, and favorable metabolic properties was identified for further experimental validation. The hdADMET model offered an alternative way to prioritize leading compounds for clinical translation through HN embeddings and deep learning.

abstract: [BJU international] Our objective was to evaluate artificial intelligence (AI)-based Gleason grading of prostate cancer (PCa) biopsies compared with expert pathologist-based consensus grading and clinical risk factors for predicting biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy. Although Gleason grading is the most validated prognostic factor in PCa, interobserver variability may affect its prognostic accuracy, particularly for intermediate-risk tumours and non-subspecialty pathologists. Whole-slide images from PCa biopsy specimens were analysed in patients originally diagnosed with grade group (GG)-2 PCa by general pathologists; patients subsequently underwent radical prostatectomy (n = 217). A representative biopsy slide containing up to two cores was analysed per case. Gleason scores were re-assigned by consensus among three genitourinary pathologists or by AI model. Cox proportional hazards models were constructed using CAPRA (Cancer of the Prostate Risk Assessment) score, percent pattern 4 (%p4), and cribriform/intraductal carcinoma, derived from either pathologist consensus or AI-based grading. Discrimination was described with Harrell's C-index; the pathologist-based and AI-based multivariable models were formally compared using Uno's C-statistic, 3- and 5-year time-dependent area under the curve, and Akaike information criterion. In total, 35 patients (16%) had BCR. In univariable models, AI-based GG had a numerically higher C-index than consensus pathologist GG (0.66 vs 0.61). Similarly, CAPRA score incorporating AI-based GG (AI-CAPRA) had a numerically higher C-index than that incorporating consensus-pathologist GG (pathologist-CAPRA) (0.68 vs 0.65). In multivariable models, AI-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma independently predicted an increased risk of BCR when combined with AI-CAPRA and AI %p4 (hazard ratio 2.97; 95% confidence interval 1.11-7.91), whereas neither pathologist-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma nor pathologist-detected %p4 was independently prognostic when combined with pathologist-CAPRA. AI-based Gleason grading had prognostic performance similar to that of expert pathologist consensus grading, alone or combined with clinical variables. AI-detected (but not pathologist-detected) cribriform/intraductal carcinoma had independent prognostic value in multivariable models with CAPRA score. abstract: [Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy] Foundation models (FMs) are transforming artificial intelligence by generating large-scale representations of data that can be adapted across diverse downstream tasks. In computational pathology, the emergence of FMs trained on whole-slide images (WSIs) promises to reduce annotation burden, improve generalization, and enable multimodal disease modeling. This review summarizes the evolution in AI and deep learning that enabled pathology FM and surveys major publicly reported models developed by both academia and industry. To construct a comprehensive and representative survey of pathology foundation models, we performed a narrative literature search targeting peer-reviewed journals, preprint repositories (arXiv, medRxiv), and major Artificial Intelligence in medicine conferences up to mid-2026. The search strategy utilized combinations of keywords including 'pathology foundation model', 'self-supervised learning whole-slide images', and 'computational pathology vision transformers'. The survey highlights the current landscape of high-performing models while discussing their clinical promise alongside key technical and implementation challenges. Pathology foundation models represent a significant shift in the field. Future directions must focus on developing multimodal architectures and achieving seamless clinical integration to fully realize their potential.

abstract: [Nature computational science] Generative models and machine learning promise accelerated material discovery in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) for CO2 capture and water harvesting, but face substantial challenges in navigating vast chemical spaces while ensuring synthesizability. Here we present MOFGen, a system of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) comprising interconnected agents: a large language model that proposes MOF compositions, a diffusion model that generates crystal structures, quantum mechanical agents that optimize and filter candidates, and synthetic-feasibility agents guided by expert rules and machine learning. Trained on a broad set of experimentally reported MOFs and computational databases, MOFGen generated hundreds of thousands of MOF structures and synthesizable organic linkers. The uniqueness of our approach lies in its ability to generate large MOF structures with atomic precision, beyond the scale of conventional generative models limited to tens of atoms. This approach was validated through high-throughput experiments and the successful synthesis of four 'AI-dreamt' MOFs.

title: GPT-4-Assisted Versus Human Detection of Intraoperative Adverse Events From Spine Surgery Operative Reports.

abstract: [Neurosurgery practice] Manual chart review remains the primary method of clinical data collection in spine surgery research but is time intensive and prone to human error. Large language models may enable automated extraction of clinically meaningful events from unstructured operative text. We evaluated the performance of generative pre-trained transformer 4 (GPT-4) in detecting intraoperative adverse events from spine surgery operative notes compared with trained human reviewers. A retrospective cohort of 1454 laminectomy cases performed at a single academic institution between 2016 and 2022 was analyzed. Deidentified operative notes were independently reviewed by 4 trained human reviewers and GPT-4 using standardized prompts to identify incidental durotomy and nondurotomy intraoperative adverse events. Discordant classifications were adjudicated by a senior reviewer to establish ground truth. Performance metrics including sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, and F1 score were calculated. Analyses were stratified by operative note length, and review time was estimated. Incidental durotomy occurred in 88 cases (6.1%). GPT-4 achieved 100.0% sensitivity compared with 89.8% for human reviewers, with lower positive predictive value (88.0% vs 100.0%) but similar specificity (99.1% vs 100.0%). For nondurotomy adverse events (n = 21), GPT-4 demonstrated higher sensitivity than humans (90.5% vs 57.1%) with equivalent specificity (100.0%). GPT-4 maintained stable performance across note length quartiles, whereas human reviewer sensitivity decreased for longer notes. Human reviewers required approximately 35 hours to review all notes, compared with approximately 2 hours for GPT-4. GPT-4 demonstrated higher observed sensitivity than trained human reviewers for detecting intraoperative adverse events from spine surgery operative reports while reducing review time by more than 90%. Large language model-assisted chart review may serve as a scalable human-in-the-loop adjunct to traditional chart review, improving the completeness and efficiency of neurosurgical outcomes research.
zh_abstract: [Neurosurgery practice] 人工病历审查仍是脊柱外科研究中临床数据收集的主要方法，但耗时且易出现人为错误。大语言模型或可从非结构化手术文本中自动提取具有临床意义的事件。我们评估了生成式预训练转换器4（GPT-4）在脊柱手术记录中检测术中不良事件的表现，并与经过培训的人工审查者进行比较。分析了一个单一学术机构在2016年至2022年间实施的1454例椎板切除术的回顾性队列。去标识化的手术记录由4名经过培训的人工审查者和GPT-4使用标准化提示独立审查，以识别意外硬脊膜切开和非硬脊膜切开类术中不良事件。不一致的分类由一名资深审查者裁定，以确立金标准。计算了敏感性、特异性、预测值和F1分数等性能指标。按手术记录长度分层分析，并估算了审查时间。意外硬脊膜切开发生于88例（6.1%）。GPT-4的敏感性为100.0%，人工审查者为89.8%；阳性预测值较低（88.0% vs 100.0%），特异性相近（99.1% vs 100.0%）。对于非硬脊膜切开类不良事件（n = 21），GPT-4的敏感性高于人工（90.5% vs 57.1%），特异性相当（100.0%）。GPT-4在各手术记录长度四分位数中表现稳定，而人工审查者的敏感性在较长记录中下降。人工审查者审查全部记录约需35小时，GPT-4约需2小时。在检测脊柱手术报告中的术中不良事件方面，GPT-4的观察敏感性高于经过培训的人工审查者，同时将审查时间缩短了90%以上。大语言模型辅助的病历审查可作为传统病历审查的可扩展人机协同辅助手段，提高神经外科结局研究的完整性和效率。

title: Deciphering state bridges via a single-cell large language model
zh_title: 通过单细胞大语言模型解析状态桥

key_points: 基于UCE统一36种细胞类型注释
614个状态嵌入为36维组成变化向量
发现22,161个显著状态桥(P<0.05)
reason: 大规模单细胞基础模型应用，预印本，缺验证信息
abstract: Large-scale single-cell transcriptomic data provide a new avenue for precision medicine by uncovering cellular heterogeneity. However, systematic comparison of remodeling patterns across various biological states remains unavailable. Here, we first developed a computational framework based on a foundation model of single cell biology, Universal Cell Embedding (UCE), to harmonize annotations comprising 36 cell types. Based on an integrated dataset of single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) with 8,789 human samples comprising more than 59 million cells or nuclei across 614 biological states, we then embedded each state with a 36-dimensional vector in a unified space of cell-composition change and further deciphered states bridges by analyzing the relationships among the 614 state vectors. As a result, 22,161 significant bridges (P < 0.05) between the 614 states were revealed. Moreover, we successfully identified a number of well-known bridges such as bridge between Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease (P = 2.21e-15), suggesting the effectiveness of the proposed framework. More importantly, we uncovered a number of new bridges. Furthermore, analyses of the number of changed cell types (NCC) and Shannon entropy revealed heterogeneous and tissue-dependent patterns of cellular composition remodeling. This study provides a new strategy for identifying disease associations and potential therapeutic relationships by deciphering bridges between biological states from scRNA-seq landscape.
zh_abstract: 大规模单细胞转录组数据通过揭示细胞异质性，为精准医学提供了新途径。然而，目前仍缺乏对不同生物学状态下重塑模式的系统比较。在此，我们首先基于单细胞生物学基础模型通用细胞嵌入（Universal Cell Embedding，UCE）开发了一个计算框架，以统一包含36种细胞类型的注释。基于整合的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集（包含8,789份人类样本、涵盖614种生物学状态的超过5,900万个细胞或细胞核），我们在细胞组成变化的统一空间中用一个36维向量嵌入每种状态，并通过分析614个状态向量之间的关系进一步解析状态桥（state bridges）。结果揭示了614种状态之间22,161个显著的桥（P < 0.05）。此外，我们成功识别出若干已知的桥，如阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病之间的桥（P = 2.21e-15），提示所提出框架的有效性。更重要的是，我们发现了许多新的桥。进一步地，对变化细胞类型数（NCC）和香农熵的分析揭示了细胞组成重塑的异质性和组织依赖性模式。本研究通过从scRNA-seq图谱中解析生物学状态之间的桥，为识别疾病关联和潜在治疗关系提供了新策略。

title: Toward a digital twin of the ICU patient: Forecasting and treatment response in a generative event model
zh_title: ICU患者数字孪生：生成式事件模型预测与治疗反应
summary: 在单一医疗系统12.7万ICU患者上训练79M参数Transformer TWICE，通过模拟未来预测19项结局，AUROC 0.836，与最佳监督配置相当。

无任务特定训练，平均AUROC 0.836 vs 0.834
评估含反事实验证与个体轨迹

abstract: A digital twin of a patient in intensive care would forecast the patient's course and what a treatment would change. Generative event models, trained to continue a patient's electronic health record (EHR), have been proposed as a path toward such twins. We trained TWICE, a 79M-parameter decoder-only transformer, on the ICU records of one academic health system (127,332 training patients and 1.57 billion tokens). We evaluated it on clinical prediction tasks, generation fidelity, individual trajectories and counterfactual validation. Reading 19 clinical outcomes off 50 simulated futures, with no task-specific training, TWICE matched the best of 144 supervised configurations on held-out patients (mean AUROC 0.836 vs. 0.834). It led on events that change care within a day and trailed on death. With the training data fixed, more and longer simulated futures were worth more than a 6.8-fold larger model. Its generated records matched real ones closely and were as specific to each patient as its own variability allowed. Its predicted risk rose as events approached. Pre-specified controls showed that it reproduced the side effects of drugs and was barely moved by an inert drug. On the values that treatments are given to correct, however, an opposite treatment moved its forecasts like the right one. TWICE forecasts ICU events about as well as task-specific models, and we see it as a step toward a digital twin of the ICU patient.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房中患者的数字孪生可以预测患者的病程以及某项治疗会带来的改变。经训练可延续患者电子健康记录（EHR）的生成式事件模型，已被提出作为实现此类孪生的途径。我们在一个学术医疗系统的 ICU 记录上（127,332 例训练患者，15.7 亿个 token）训练了 TWICE，这是一个 7900 万参数的仅解码器 Transformer。我们在临床预测任务、生成保真度、个体轨迹和反事实验证方面对其进行了评估。在不进行任何特定任务训练的情况下，TWICE 从 50 个模拟未来中读取 19 项临床结局，在留出患者上与 144 种监督配置中的最佳者相当（平均 AUROC 0.836 对 0.834）。它在一天内会改变诊疗的事件上领先，而在死亡预测上落后。在训练数据固定的情况下，更多、更长的模拟未来比 6.8 倍大的模型更有价值。其生成的记录与真实记录高度吻合，并且对每位患者的特异性达到了其自身变异性所允许的程度。随着事件临近，其预测风险上升。预先设定的对照显示，它重现了药物的副作用，并且几乎不受惰性药物影响。然而，对于治疗所要纠正的那些数值，相反的治疗与正确的治疗对其预测的影响相同。TWICE 对 ICU 事件的预测效果与特定任务模型大致相当，我们认为这是迈向 ICU 患者数字孪生的一步。

title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
zh_title: SonoAtlasWorld：以解剖为状态的超声世界模型
summary: 提出以CT提取的3D解剖资产为锚的超声世界模型，用于机器人超声策略学习的数据生成与评估。
key_points: 以CT提取的持久3D解剖资产作为状态
探头动作决定解剖与声学可见性条件
三阶段流程：预训练、因果转换、长程对齐
reason: 预印本，医学世界模型新方法，加分但验证有限
abstract: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.
zh_abstract: 学习机器人超声策略需要可交互的环境，以便进行可扩展的数据生成和可重复的评估，而在真实患者身上进行探索则受到采集成本和安全约束的限制。生成式世界模型提供了一种替代方案，但仅凭图像历史和探头动作并不能保证在大范围扫查和声窗变化过程中解剖结构的一致性。我们提出 SonoAtlasWorld，这是一种以解剖结构作为状态的超声世界模型。从计算机断层扫描（CT）中提取的持久性三维解剖资产将每次扫查锚定到特定解剖结构。探头动作决定了因果超声生成器的解剖和声学可见性条件，该生成器在临床视频上训练。我们的三阶段流程结合了解剖条件预训练、因果转换和长序列滚动对齐。推理优化使位姿到超声的吞吐量达到 81.2 FPS。为了评估超越图像相似性的解剖控制能力，我们提出了动作跟随指数（AFI），其衡量相对于静态前缀基线的归一化重建增益。在 40 个留出的三维体数据上，SonoAtlasWorld 的肝脏和宏观器官 AFI 分别为 0.428 和 0.262，而所测试的动作条件和几何条件方法最高分别仅为 0.117 和 0.038。长序列滚动对齐使 40 次重复扫查周期结束时的亮度漂移降低了 3.46 倍。SonoAtlasWorld 还可生成离线策略训练示范，并支持基于解剖结构的闭环评估。扩大生成的训练数据规模后，在模拟中对未见过的解剖结构的关键切面获取成功率从 48.2% 提高到 81.2%，表明其对机器人超声策略学习具有实用价值。

title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
zh_title: FlowScope：3D场景流预训练提升手术机器人策略
summary: 用无标注临床立体视频预测场景流来预训练手术策略网络，在真实手术机器人系统上提高针拾取等任务成功率。
key_points: 在1149例手术、135万片段上预训练ACT主干
针拾取成功率由54%升至90%
推理无额外开销，完整任务2%升至14%
reason: 预印本，大规模临床视频预训练并真实机器人验证
abstract: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

title: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
zh_title: 基于H&E与mIF的可解释肿瘤免疫微环境推理
summary: 提出利用同切片H&E与多重免疫荧光提供逐步真值，让多模态大模型输出可验证的肿瘤免疫微环境推理，而非仅给最终答案。

mIF无需人工标注即可给出细胞级逐步真值
针对仅奖励最终答案的R1式强化学习缺陷

abstract: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest open-weight baseline. Without the process reward, reinforcement learning barely improves on supervised fine-tuning (80.0% vs. 78.8%) and fewer stated quantities are correct; editing a decisive stated quantity changes the answer as implied in all 885 test questions. Without retraining, it keeps the highest average accuracy on an external cohort imaged with CODEX (76.4% vs. 67.3%) and on head and neck cancer, a cancer type absent from training (76.7% vs. 72.5%).

abstract: [Minerva anestesiologica] Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs have transformed perioperative care through standardized, evidence-based pathways, improving outcomes across surgical specialties. However, increasing patient complexity and heterogeneity expose important limitations of protocol-driven approaches, which often fail to capture dynamic physiological variability and individualized recovery trajectories. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a pathway to overcome these constraints by integrating longitudinal perioperative data and generating individualized risk predictions. However, prediction alone is insufficient for clinically meaningful personalization, which requires causal reasoning to estimate which interventions are most likely to improve outcomes for specific patients and at different stages of recovery. In this context, ERAS may evolve toward a data-informed, adaptive care system that integrates prediction, causal inference, and supervised workflow coordination. Emerging agentic AI systems may further extend ERAS beyond passive decision support toward structured care orchestration within defined clinical governance boundaries. This review examines how different AI methodologies, including supervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, generative models, and causal inference, can be aligned with ERAS objectives across the perioperative continuum. We also critically evaluate current evidence and key barriers to implementation. Looking forward, the convergence of AI, digital health technologies, and continuous patient monitoring may enable the emergence of cognitive ERAS, a data-driven perioperative care model that integrates prediction, causal estimation, and continuous learning to deliver personalized and dynamically adaptive recovery pathways.

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Protein thermodynamic stability changes upon mutation profoundly affect protein structure and biological function. Recent advances in deep learning and protein language models have provided powerful tools for computational analysis of mutation-induced stability changes. However, most existing methods focus on quantitative regression of free-energy changes, which places strong dependence on precise experimentally measured ΔΔG values, although reliably determining the direction of stability change is itself an important objective in many practical applications. Here, we propose BlindDDG, a novel framework that reformulates protein mutation stability prediction from quantitative ΔΔG estimation to direction-oriented stability change classification. First, we introduce a blind-evaluation strategy that models mutation-induced changes by learning the representation difference between wild-type and mutant proteins, rather than relying solely on their individual intrinsic properties. This formulation focuses on the direction of stability changes and reduces the dependence on precise quantitative ΔΔG measurements. Second, a Siamese architecture with shared parameters is employed to encode the wild-type and mutant states and capture subtle mutation-associated differences. Third, a local structure-aware cross-attention mechanism is developed to integrate mutation-centered structural information with global protein language model representations, enabling effective multimodal feature interaction. Experimental results on the independent S669 benchmark demonstrate that BlindDDG achieves strong classification performance, obtaining an F1 score of 0.5449, an MCC of 0.3929, an accuracy of 0.7721, and a recall of 0.5417 for stabilizing mutation identification. BlindDDG outperforms all evaluated methods in F1 score, MCC, accuracy, and recall, highlighting its effectiveness in capturing mutation-induced stability changes, particularly for imbalanced stability classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 突变引起的蛋白质热力学稳定性变化深刻影响蛋白质的结构和生物学功能。深度学习和蛋白质语言模型的最新进展为突变诱导稳定性变化的计算分析提供了强大工具。然而，大多数现有方法侧重于自由能变化的定量回归，这强烈依赖于实验测得的精确ΔΔG值，尽管在许多实际应用中，可靠判定稳定性变化的方向本身就是一个重要目标。在此，我们提出BlindDDG，这是一种新框架，将蛋白质突变稳定性预测从定量ΔΔG估计重新表述为面向方向的稳定性变化分类。首先，我们引入一种盲评估策略，通过学习野生型与突变型蛋白质之间的表示差异来建模突变诱导的变化，而不是仅依赖于它们各自的内在性质。这种表述聚焦于稳定性变化的方向，并降低了对精确定量ΔΔG测量的依赖。其次，采用参数共享的孪生（Siamese）架构对野生型和突变型状态进行编码，以捕捉与突变相关的细微差异。第三，开发了一种局部结构感知的交叉注意力机制，将以突变为中心的结构信息与全局蛋白质语言模型表示相整合，实现有效的多模态特征交互。在独立的S669基准上的实验结果表明，BlindDDG取得了很强的分类性能，在稳定化突变识别方面F1分数为0.5449，MCC为0.3929，准确率为0.7721，召回率为0.5417。BlindDDG在F1分数、MCC、准确率和召回率方面均优于所有被评估方法，突显了其在捕捉突变诱导稳定性变化方面的有效性，尤其适用于不平衡的稳定性分类。

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Most CRISPR-Cas9 design tools select guide RNAs (gRNAs) by ranking predefined candidates rather than actively optimizing them. Here we instead formulate SpCas9 spacer refinement as a constrained search problem, in which a limited number of nucleotide substitutions may be introduced outside the PAM-proximal seed region. The search is driven by a thermodynamically grounded objective that combines CRISPRspec-based specificity with penalties for suboptimal GC content and long homopolymer runs. Within this single setting we compare five search strategies: three reinforcement-learning (RL) policies, which are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Quantile-Regression Deep Q-Network (QR-DQN), and Rainbow Deep Q-Network (Rainbow DQN), together with a nonlearning score-guided search and a prompt-guided large language model (LLM). All five share the same objective, mutable positions, substitution budget, and evaluation protocol, so that only the search strategy differs. On 100 held-out IGF2R guides from a gene and chromosome excluded from training, every strategy significantly reduced the predicted off-target burden (38.6-78.3%) and improved independent specificity metrics without degrading on-target scores. The strategies nevertheless differed sharply in per-guide safety: the LLM achieved the largest aggregate reduction but introduced new off-target sites into 38% of guides that were initially free of them, whereas PPO, an on-policy RL algorithm, retained a strong gain with the lowest regression rate of 15%. These results show that the thermodynamic objective supplies a robust common optimization signal, while the choice of search strategy governs the trade-off between aggregate improvement and regression of already-favorable guides.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 大多数CRISPR-Cas9设计工具通过对预定义候选序列排序来选择向导RNA（gRNA），而非主动对其进行优化。本文将SpCas9间隔序列优化表述为一个受约束的搜索问题，即可在PAM近端种子区之外引入有限数量的核苷酸替换。搜索由一个基于热力学的目标函数驱动，该函数将基于CRISPRspec的特异性与对不理想GC含量和较长同聚物序列的惩罚相结合。在这一统一设定下，我们比较了五种搜索策略：三种强化学习（RL）策略，即近端策略优化（PPO）、分位数回归深度Q网络（QR-DQN）和Rainbow深度Q网络（Rainbow DQN），以及一种非学习的评分引导搜索和一种提示引导的大语言模型（LLM）。这五种策略共享相同的目标函数、可变位置、替换预算和评估方案，因此仅搜索策略不同。在来自训练中排除的基因和染色体的100条留出IGF2R向导上，每种策略均显著降低了预测的脱靶负担（38.6–78.3%），并改善了独立的特异性指标，且未降低靶向评分。然而，各策略在单条向导的安全性方面差异明显：LLM实现了最大的总体降幅，但在38%原本无脱靶位点的向导中引入了新的脱靶位点；而作为同策略（on-policy）RL算法的PPO保持了显著的改善，回退率最低，为15%。这些结果表明，热力学目标函数提供了稳健的通用优化信号，而搜索策略的选择决定了总体改善与原本良好向导发生回退之间的权衡。

abstract: [Molecular biomedicine] Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy for eliminating disease-associated proteins, including targets that remain challenging to modulate using conventional occupancy-driven inhibitors. Among TPD approaches, proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) exploit the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) to induce selective and event-driven degradation of proteins of interest (POIs). Despite rapid advances in PROTAC development, successful translation depends on interconnected determinants, including target degradability, ubiquitin ligase (E3) recruitment, warhead and linker properties, ternary-complex formation, ubiquitination efficiency, intracellular exposure, and pharmacokinetic behavior. This review provides an integrated, mechanism-oriented analysis of these determinants by linking PROTAC design, ubiquitination biology, computational approaches, and clinical development. We examine key principles governing PROTAC-mediated degradation, with emphasis on E3-ligase selection, linker design, ternary-complex geometry and cooperativity, ubiquitin (Ub)-acceptor lysine (Lys) accessibility, ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme (E2)/E3 context, proteasomal engagement, inefficient degradation, and the hook effect. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning for degradation-activity prediction, E3-ligase/POI pairing, ligand and linker optimization, ternary-complex modeling, and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) assessment are critically evaluated alongside their technical and translational limitations. Preclinical developments, clinical-stage degraders, emerging TPD modalities, and major barriers to translation are also discussed. We propose an integrated framework linking distinct target ubiquitination patterns, degrader design, ternary-complex geometry, AI-enabled prediction, and pharmacokinetic/clinical constraints, providing a mechanism-informed roadmap for the rational development of next-generation protein degraders and identifying mechanistic bottlenecks and translational priorities across therapeutic settings.
zh_abstract: 【分子生物医学】靶向蛋白降解（TPD）已成为清除疾病相关蛋白的变革性治疗策略，包括那些传统占位驱动型抑制剂难以调控的靶点。在TPD方法中，蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC）利用泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）诱导目标蛋白（POI）的选择性、事件驱动型降解。尽管PROTAC开发进展迅速，但成功转化取决于一系列相互关联的决定因素，包括靶点可降解性、泛素连接酶（E3）招募、弹头和连接子特性、三元复合物形成、泛素化效率、细胞内暴露量以及药代动力学行为。本综述通过将PROTAC设计、泛素化生物学、计算方法和临床开发联系起来，对这些决定因素进行了整合的、以机制为导向的分析。我们探讨了支配PROTAC介导降解的关键原则，重点包括E3连接酶选择、连接子设计、三元复合物几何构型与协同性、泛素（Ub）受体赖氨酸（Lys）可及性、泛素结合酶（E2）/E3背景、蛋白酶体结合、低效降解以及钩状效应（hook effect）。我们还批判性地评估了人工智能（AI）和机器学习在降解活性预测、E3连接酶/POI配对、配体和连接子优化、三元复合物建模以及吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）评估方面的最新进展及其技术和转化局限。此外还讨论了临床前进展、临床阶段降解剂、新兴TPD模式以及转化的主要障碍。我们提出了一个整合框架，将不同的靶点泛素化模式、降解剂设计、三元复合物几何构型、AI赋能的预测以及药代动力学/临床限制联系起来，为下一代蛋白降解剂的合理开发提供基于机制的路线图，并识别各类治疗场景中的机制瓶颈和转化重点。

abstract: [Discover artificial intelligence] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in various clinical settings to support clinical reasoning and decision-making. Although they have demonstrated strong performance on medical knowledge and reasoning tasks, and early studies suggest potential to reduce medical errors, emerging evidence also highlights important safety concerns, including clinically significant management errors in outputs that may not be readily apparent to users. How these tools can be integrated into clinical practice to consistently lead to improved patient outcomes remains an open question. AI-assisted reasoning unfolds across a sequence of decisions: whether to use AI for the clinical question, how to engage with the tool, how to interpret its output, and whether to act. Each stage in this sequence introduces distinct risks, including inappropriate tool selection, incomplete or biased inputs, overconfidence in fluent responses, and failure to recognize error or appreciate nuance. These risks are further shaped by the same clinician factors that generally affect clinical reasoning such as experience, workload, and uncertainty management. Viewing the AI-clinician interaction as a process rather than a single moment highlights several key points of vulnerability but also opportunities for training. Ultimately, the safe use of AI may depend less on the quality of the model and more on the clinician's ability to recognize when its outputs should be questioned, verified, or set aside.
zh_abstract: [探索人工智能] 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于各类临床场景，以支持临床推理和决策。尽管它们在医学知识和推理任务上表现出色，且早期研究提示其有减少医疗差错的潜力，但新近证据也凸显了重要的安全性问题，包括输出中存在具有临床意义的处置错误，而使用者可能不易察觉。这些工具如何整合进临床实践并持续带来更好的患者结局，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。AI辅助推理是在一系列决策中展开的：是否针对该临床问题使用AI、如何与工具互动、如何解读其输出，以及是否据此行动。这一序列中的每个阶段都带来不同的风险，包括工具选择不当、输入不完整或有偏倚、对流畅回答过度自信，以及未能识别错误或体察细微差别。这些风险又受到同样影响临床推理的临床医生因素的塑造，例如经验、工作负荷和不确定性管理。将AI与临床医生的互动视为一个过程而非单一时刻，既凸显了若干关键的脆弱点，也带来了培训的机会。归根结底，AI能否安全使用，可能更取决于临床医生能否识别何时应对其输出提出质疑、加以核实或弃之不用，而非模型本身的质量。

abstract: [Pediatric blood & cancer] The data generated by cooperative-group clinical trials have transformed outcomes for children with cancer, yet the infrastructure underlying their collection and use has not kept pace with advances in informatics and data science. Data collection on pediatric oncology trials remains largely manual: Clinical research assistants abstract values from medical records and key them into electronic case report forms, a process that is costly, slow, inconsistent, and error-prone. Data are often siloed within trial networks for years after a study closes, limiting their value for secondary research, particularly for rare cancers. In this consensus blueprint, an interdisciplinary group of pediatric oncologists, clinical informaticians, data scientists, nurses, clinical research assistants, drug developers, and parent advocates outlines a pragmatic path forward across three components of the data lifecycle: collection, processing, and sharing. We argue that case report forms should be bound to standardized common data elements; that automated data abstraction from electronic health records, including via large language models with human-in-the-loop validation, should replace much of today's manual abstraction; that paper chemotherapy roadmaps should be reconceived as computable artifacts; and that clinical trials data should be deposited in publicly accessible repositories with appropriate governance as soon as practically feasible. We discuss facilitators and barriers within each component, including standards adoption, regulatory complexity, financial sustainability, and workforce capacity. We propose concrete actions for funders, clinical trials networks, professional societies, and industry. The technology to achieve these goals exists today, and widespread adoption requires coordinated leadership, sustainable funding models, and a cultural shift that recognizes data stewardship as an ethical imperative and a duty to the children and families we serve.

title: A2Holo: Dual-Stream Flow Matching of 3D Structure and a Protein Language Model for Conformational Transition Prediction

summary: 将apo到holo构象预测视为两个实验结构间的流匹配，在D3PM基准上取得中位Cα RMSD 0.809 Å，为现有方法最低。

abstract: Modelling a ligand-bound holo conformation from a ligand-free apo conformation is essential in structure-based drug discovery. We present A2Holo, which casts apo-to-holo prediction as flow matching between two experimental structures rather than generation from noise. It transplants the dual-stream joint attention of in-context image generation to residue-aligned protein language model embeddings and structure. Without ligand conditioning or stochastic sampling, A2Holo's single deterministic trajectory reaches a median C RMSD of 0.809 [A] on the D3PM benchmark, the lowest among existing methods. Its TM-score exceeds even the best of 10 samples from every stochastic baseline on at least 144 of 150 pairs. Beyond performance, we directly measure the transplanted multimodal mechanism itself. Because sequence and structure are residue-aligned, its joint attention can be measured at residue resolution and tested for reproducibility across independently trained model variants. Within the structure stream, the attention a residue receives recovers moving residues better than the attention it emits, and this asymmetry is learned. A2Holo demonstrates a successful multimodal transplant from in-context image generation to protein conformational change, with strong deterministic apo-to-holo prediction. It also provides a quantitative account of how that mechanism organises residue-aligned sequence and structure around the residues that move.

abstract: Prokaryotic gene prediction is often considered solved, yet widely used tools still disagree on many genes, chiefly short genes and translation starts. We present deeprok, an ab initio prokaryotic gene prediction method that combines a base-level neural network with an overlap-aware decoder, and refines start-site predictions with a self-trained neural ranker. On four curated genomes distant from its training data, deeprok made 10-18% fewer exact-match errors than Prodigal and GeneMarkS-2, and on 2,925 experimentally verified starts it made 21-41% fewer start errors. Furthermore, deeprok's base-level architecture reveals lineage-specific translation initiation signals. These results show that per-base deep learning combined with overlap-aware decoding can improve prokaryotic gene prediction, especially for resolving translation starts.

abstract: [Proceedings of the ... International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications. International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications] Conditional generative adversarial networks (cGANs) have enabled high-fidelity computational staining and destaining of hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) in digital pathology whole-slide images (WSI). However, their ability to generalize to out-of-distribution WSIs across institutions without retraining remains insufficiently characterized, limiting scalable clinical translation. Previously developed cGAN models trained on 102 registered prostate core biopsy WSIs from Brigham and Women's Hospital were evaluated on 82 spatially unregistered WSIs from three Stanford University patients. To mitigate domain shift without retraining, a preprocessing pipeline consisting of histogram-based stain normalization for H&E-stained WSIs and channel-wise intensity calibration for unstained WSIs was developed. Because image registration was intentionally omitted for real-world deployment conditions, the reported quantitative results are conservative lower bounds reflecting both model performance and limited spatial alignment. Under these conditions, virtual destaining achieved a Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.854, structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.699, and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 18.41 dB. H&E restaining from computationally destained outputs outperformed direct staining from ground-truth unstained inputs across all metrics (PCC: 0.798 vs. 0.715; SSIM: 0.756 vs. 0.718; PSNR: 20.08 vs. 18.51 dB), suggesting that preprocessing quality may be more limiting than model capacity. Qualitative pathological review indicated that benign glandular structures were more reliably preserved, and malignant glands were often rendered with vessel-like morphologies. These findings support the feasibility of applying cGAN-based computational H&E staining and destaining generative models to external WSI datasets using preprocessing-based adaptation alone, and identify malignant gland preservation for future domain adaptation.

abstract: Medical agents built on large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet most stay fixed once deployed and do not keep using their experience to improve later attempts. As a result, the same kind of error can recur across patients. To address this, existing self-improvement methods update an agent's weights or its medical harness from its own experience, but their improving strategy stays fixed and never learns which changes actually help, which caps how much the agent can improve. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) instead improves both the agent and its improving strategy. However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later. We propose MedicalRSI, an RSI framework built on Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution, in which one model plays two roles. The Solver is the medical agent itself, and the Improver is its learnable improving strategy, which writes a medical harness from the agent's failures. Each harness is rewarded by its gain over acting without it, and both roles are trained together, so the Improver keeps adapting to the problems the Solver has not yet solved. On multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones, MedicalRSI outperforms existing context-level and weight-level self-improvement methods and transfers well to unseen workflows, new LLMs and new databases, a step toward medical agents that keep improving.

abstract: Many medical image processing tasks, such as completing missing regions or correcting acquisition artifacts, can be cast as volumetric generation conditioned on observations of the same patient. Diffusion Transformers offer scalable capacity and flexible conditioning for this setting, but they operate on a learned image representation that must preserve fine anatomical and pathological detail while keeping complete three-dimensional volumes tractable. We bring Transformer variational autoencoding and multimodal diffusion together to address this challenge. Trained on BrainTumor-256K, a 249M Transformer VAE encodes and decodes $256^3$ volumes 7.6x faster than a comparably sized CNN trained on the same collection. Their PSNR difference is near zero with training-sized crop inputs, but the Transformer leads by 0.749 dB with full-volume inputs and an unchanged scoring region. Increasing Transformer capacity to 499M improves PSNR across all four brain MRI evaluation sets while retaining 3.8x lower encoding-decoding latency than the CNN. Fast encoding also allows conditions to be constructed dynamically in image space during latent diffusion training. Within the compressed representation, a shared Diffusion Transformer integrates text and spatial references for volumetric synthesis, completion and restoration. The brain-trained autoencoder further transfers to non-brain MRI and CT without target-domain fine-tuning, extending its use beyond the anatomy and modality on which it was learned. The framework provides a reusable representation and conditioning interface for efficient, controllable medical image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/OncoMMAI/brainmri-vit-vae3d.

abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) provides a noninvasive view of functional interactions across the brain, which can be represented as connectivity graphs for neurological disease analysis. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being paired with such representations, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason over the underlying connectivity or simply respond to surface-level cues that may trigger learned priors. We probe this question through a controlled study of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) diagnosis from resting-state functional connectivity, isolating one factor at a time to determine what drives an LLM's predictions on brain connectivity graphs. Across six models, from small open-weight LLMs to a proprietary one, the same pattern holds: the results provide little evidence that predictions are consistently grounded in subject-specific connectivity. Brain region names, numeric formatting, and prompt framing shift what a model predicts without improving how well it separates ADHD subjects from Controls; perturbing the graph changes predictions no more for clinically meaningful regions than for random ones; and the models' own justifications contradict the values they cite, inconsistently interpreting the connectivity evidence provided to them. Across every probe, predictions follow the model's built-in class bias and the surface form of the prompt rather than the subject's connectivity, calling into question a premise underlying current LLM brain integration work. Our code is available at https://github.com/Roy025/ADHD-code.

abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) by medical students has created two significant concerns: that students will use artificial intelligence (AI) for quick answers, short-circuiting the cognitive effort essential for deep learning, and that the satisfaction of discovery will be lost to algorithmic efficiency. This Scholarly Perspective reframes LLMs not as information retrieval systems, but as "Socratic Mirrors": interactive tutors grounded in established learning science (such as the desirable level of difficulty, social constructivism and zone of proximal development, the illusion of explanatory depth, and dual coding theory) that can restore the productive struggle that traditional LLMs often constrain. Drawing on the three functions of education framework, the authors argue that by handling qualification (the foundational work of content mastery), Socratic tutors free faculty to focus on what AI cannot provide: socialization (initiation into the norms and values of the profession) and subjectification (the formation of physicians as autonomous, ethical, and reflective practitioners). This potential is not merely theoretical. Empirical evidence from randomized controlled trials suggests that pedagogically engineered AI tutors, those designed to scaffold discovery rather than deliver answers, can significantly outperform traditional instruction. The studies demonstrate how LLMs configured as Socratic tutors can address the "2-Sigma" problem, offering personalized one-on-one tutoring at scale and moving medical education closer to the ideal of precision education. However, these studies are drawn from outside medical education, and the inferential leap to medical training, while theoretically grounded, remains empirically undemonstrated. The PICRAT (passive, interactive, creative, replacement, amplification, transformation) model is presented as a technology integration framework to ensure intentional rather than reactive AI integration. Together, these principles suggest a promising pathway toward scalable precision medical education that warrants formal evaluation in medical education contexts.
zh_abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] 医学生对大语言模型（LLMs）的迅速采用引发了两方面的重大担忧：学生可能使用人工智能（AI）快速获取答案，从而绕过深度学习所必需的认知努力；以及发现的满足感将因算法效率而丧失。这篇学术观点文章将 LLMs 重新定位为“苏格拉底之镜”（Socratic Mirrors），而非信息检索系统：这是一种以既有学习科学（如适度困难、社会建构主义与最近发展区、解释深度错觉以及双重编码理论）为基础的交互式导师，能够恢复传统 LLMs 常常限制的“有成效的挣扎”。作者借鉴教育三功能框架，提出：通过承担资格化（qualification，即内容掌握的基础性工作），苏格拉底式导师可使教师专注于 AI 无法提供的部分：社会化（socialization，即引入职业规范与价值观）和主体化（subjectification，即将医生塑造为自主、有伦理且具反思能力的从业者）。这一潜力并非仅停留在理论层面。随机对照试验的实证证据表明，经教学工程设计的 AI 导师（即旨在搭建发现过程的支架而非直接给出答案者）可显著优于传统教学。这些研究展示了配置为苏格拉底式导师的 LLMs 如何应对“2-Sigma”问题，大规模提供个性化的一对一辅导，并使医学教育更接近精准教育的理想。然而，这些研究均来自医学教育之外，向医学培训的推论虽有理论依据，但在实证上仍未得到证明。文中提出 PICRAT（被动、互动、创造、替代、增强、转化）模型作为技术整合框架，以确保有意图而非被动反应式地整合 AI。综上，这些原则提示了一条通往可扩展精准医学教育的有前景路径，值得在医学教育情境中进行正式评估。

abstract: [BMC oral health] Accurate identification of mandibular invasion by oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is important for virtual surgical planning, but manual delineation on CT is challenging and time-consuming. This retrospective proof-of-concept study evaluated automated segmentation of the mandible and radiologically apparent bone invasion and explored centerline-based assessment of longitudinal tumor extent for computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM) planning. Fifty preoperative CT examinations from 50 patients with histopathologically confirmed mandibular invasion were included. Thirty examinations were used for model development and 20 for independent testing. A three-dimensional MedNeXt architecture implemented within nnU-Net was trained applying expert-reviewed CT reference segmentations. Performance was assessed using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), precision, recall, average symmetric surface distance and 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance. Spatial localization, longitudinal invasion-span differences and signed centerline-projected endpoint errors were assessed in the holdout cohort. Mean mandibular DSC was 0.965 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.961-0.969; median 0.967). Mean invasion DSC was 0.553 (95% CI, 0.425-0.660; median 0.623), with mean precision of 0.742 and recall of 0.483. Predicted invasion overlapped the CT reference in 18/20 examinations (90%); 16/20 (80%) achieved DSC ≥ 0.20. Two cases were completely missed. Among the 18 evaluable cases, the median absolute invasion-span difference was 7.01 mm (interquartile range, 5.08-13.00 mm) and the median symmetric endpoint distance was 5.88 mm (3.19-9.16 mm). The present proof-of-concept study demonstrates the technical feasibility of automated CT segmentation of the mandible and radiologically apparent mandibular invasion by OSCC. The approach may support transmission of radiological tumor extent into virtual resection planning. Larger multicenter studies and prospective clinical validation are needed to establish its impact on planning accuracy and workflow efficiency.

abstract: [International orthodontics] To present a fully automated artificial intelligence (AI) workflow to generate personalized orthodontic target set-ups and compare the quality of the occlusal outcome with manual set-ups, using the American Board of Orthodontics Model Grading System (ABO MGS). The AI workflow takes an intraoral scan and performs tooth segmentation, landmark detection, tooth completion, and tooth alignment to generate a 3D-printable personalized set-up without human intervention. The occlusal outcome was evaluated on twenty non-extraction full jaw cases treated with customized fixed appliances by comparing the AI set-ups to manual set-ups made by experienced laboratory technicians. Both set-up series were scored with the ABO MGS for alignment and rotations, marginal ridges, buccolingual inclination, overjet, occlusal contacts, occlusal relationships, and interproximal contacts. The 'alignment and rotations' category was additionally analysed separately for the anterior (canine to canine) and posterior (premolars to second molars) segments. Paired comparisons used the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (α=0.05). Based on the total ABO MGS scores, the AI set-ups (mean: 14.95) and manual set-ups (mean: 12.20) showed high-quality occlusal outcomes, which were both far below the ABO passing score. AI set-ups showed significantly more penalty points for alignment and rotations (median: 8 vs. 5; P<0.001). This difference was confined to the posterior segments; anterior alignment was near-ideal for both methods. Other categories did not differ significantly (P=0.082-0.886). For the first time, a fully automated AI-based 3D workflow generated personalized orthodontic target set-ups for non-extraction cases with a clinically acceptable, high-quality occlusal outcome, in approximately four minutes. Posterior alignment remains the only shortcoming of the AI set-ups and is the obvious target for further algorithm refinement or brief manual correction.
zh_abstract: [International orthodontics] 本研究旨在提出一种全自动人工智能（AI）工作流程以生成个性化正畸目标排牙（set-up），并使用美国正畸委员会模型评分系统（ABO MGS）比较其咬合结果质量与手工排牙的差异。该AI工作流程以口内扫描为输入，执行牙齿分割、标志点检测、牙齿补全和牙齿排齐，无需人工干预即可生成可3D打印的个性化排牙。咬合结果在20例采用定制固定矫治器治疗的非拔牙全牙列病例上进行评估，将AI排牙与经验丰富的技师制作的手工排牙进行比较。两组排牙均按ABO MGS对排列与旋转、边缘嵴、颊舌向倾斜度、覆盖、咬合接触、咬合关系和邻接触进行评分。“排列与旋转”类别另外分别对前牙段（尖牙到尖牙）和后牙段（前磨牙到第二磨牙）进行分析。配对比较采用双侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验（α=0.05）。基于ABO MGS总分，AI排牙（均值：14.95）和手工排牙（均值：12.20）均显示出高质量的咬合结果，均远低于ABO合格分数。AI排牙在排列与旋转方面的扣分显著更多（中位数：8 vs. 5；P<0.001）。该差异局限于后牙段；两种方法的前牙排列均接近理想。其他类别无显著差异（P=0.082–0.886）。全自动的基于AI的3D工作流程首次在约四分钟内为非拔牙病例生成了个性化正畸目标排牙，咬合结果高质量且临床可接受。后牙排列仍是AI排牙唯一的不足，也是进一步改进算法或进行简短手工修正的明确目标。

title: Machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support: A concept analysis for emergency nursing.
zh_title: 机器学习辅助多发伤分诊决策支持：急诊护理概念分析
summary: 采用Walker和Avant方法，对机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持概念的属性、前因后果与边界进行分析。

abstract: [International emergency nursing] Polytrauma triage requires rapid prioritization under conditions of incomplete information, physiological instability, crowding, and high consequences of error. Machine learning (ML) is increasingly discussed as a means of strengthening emergency triage; however, the concept of ML-supported polytrauma triage decision support remains insufficiently defined for emergency nursing, particularly regarding its temporal and clinical boundaries within the emergency department. This concept analysis clarifies the meaning, defining attributes, antecedents, consequences, empirical referents, and boundaries of machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support. Walker and Avant's concept analysis method guided the analysis. A structured and traceable literature identification process was used to examine literature on polytrauma, initial emergency department triage, clinical decision support, machine learning in emergency and trauma care, digital nursing decision-making, and artificial intelligence safety. Sources were mapped using a concept-analysis matrix to identify concept uses, candidate attributes, antecedents, consequences, cases, empirical referents, and conceptual boundaries. Machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support was defined as a human-in-the-loop clinical decision support process operating within the initial emergency department triage window, in which ML integrates polytrauma-relevant information available at or immediately before the first triage decision and generates time-critical acuity or near-term deterioration estimates to inform immediate prioritization without replacing clinician judgment. Three core defining attributes were identified: polytrauma-relevant initial-triage data integration, time-critical triage risk or acuity estimation, and human-in-the-loop clinical decision support. Model validation, workflow fit and interpretability, and performance governance were distinguished from defining attributes and positioned as antecedent or implementation conditions and empirical referents for safe clinical use. The concept is distinct from conventional triage, trauma scoring, post-triage prognostic modeling, generic clinical decision support, and automated decision-making. Clarifying both its defining attributes and its temporal boundary positions ML as a support for the initial emergency nursing triage decision rather than as a substitute for professional judgment or a broader trauma management system.
zh_abstract: [International emergency nursing] 多发伤分诊需要在信息不完整、生理状态不稳定、拥挤以及错误后果严重的条件下快速确定优先级。机器学习（ML）越来越多地被讨论为加强急诊分诊的手段；然而，对于急诊护理而言，ML支持的多发伤分诊决策支持这一概念仍然定义不足，尤其是其在急诊科内的时间和临床边界。本概念分析阐明了机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持的含义、定义属性、前因、后果、经验参照物和边界。分析以Walker和Avant的概念分析方法为指导。采用结构化且可追溯的文献识别流程，检索了有关多发伤、急诊科初始分诊、临床决策支持、急诊与创伤救治中的机器学习、数字化护理决策以及人工智能安全的文献。使用概念分析矩阵对文献来源进行梳理，以识别概念用法、候选属性、前因、后果、案例、经验参照物和概念边界。机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持被定义为一种人在回路的临床决策支持过程，运行于急诊科初始分诊时间窗内；其中ML整合在首次分诊决策时或之前即刻可获得的与多发伤相关的信息，并生成时间紧迫的危重程度或近期恶化估计，以为即时优先级确定提供信息，而不取代临床医生的判断。确定了三个核心定义属性：与多发伤相关的初始分诊数据整合、时间紧迫的分诊风险或危重程度估计，以及人在回路的临床决策支持。模型验证、工作流程适配性与可解释性、以及性能治理，被区分于定义属性，并被定位为安全临床使用的前因或实施条件及经验参照物。该概念不同于传统分诊、创伤评分、分诊后预后建模、通用临床决策支持和自动化决策。明确其定义属性及时间边界，可将ML定位为对急诊护理初始分诊决策的支持，而非专业判断或更广泛创伤管理系统的替代。

title: The unedited acceptance rate: a review-fidelity metric for human-in-the-loop clinical AI

summary: 为伦敦一家门诊诊所的多智能体临床系统定义可计算的审核保真度指标（如未编辑接受率），并预先设定12周前瞻分析。

abstract: Objective. Guidance for large language model (LLM) drafting in clinical care relies on human review, yet review is rarely measured as a control. We aimed to define computable measures of review fidelity, establish which a deployed system can compute, and pre-specify their first analysis. Materials and Methods. For a multi-agent clinical system in routine use at one private London outpatient clinic, we defined acceptance coverage, attribution completeness, the unedited acceptance rate (UAR), a bounded normalized edit distance, availability latency and an unedited fast-approval rate (UFA). We checked each measure against the system's code and database structure at a fixed commit on four approval routes and pre-specified a prospective 12-week analysis. Results. The UAR equals the mass at zero of the edit-distance distribution, and availability latency bounds reading time from above only. Clinical documentation keeps draft and signed text with a recorded signer, so the core measures are computable there. Help-desk edit telemetry is written only when the agent's version has been stored. The WhatsApp agent route records no edit signal, and its approver need not be named. No route records when a draft is opened. Documentation accept events were not written before a change committed on November 16, 2026. Model-generated content, including live voice-agent speech, also reaches patients without approval. No measured values are reported. Discussion. Acceptance alone cannot separate accurate drafts from approval without reading, and three of four routes cannot yet support the family. Conclusion. Review fidelity can be specified as telemetry at the approval event. Validation against missed errors is required.

title: Asking Conversational Artificial Intelligence about Health and Subsequent Actions among Adults in Japan: A Cross-sectional Web Survey

summary: 两阶段网络问卷调查，估计日本成人向对话式AI询问健康问题的比例、目的、后续行动及信任度；约40.3%成人近6个月曾询问。

abstract: Introduction: People increasingly ask conversational artificial intelligence (AI) about health; however, how this relates to care seeking in Japan, where universal health coverage renders care accessible, remains unknown. This study described how many adults ask AI about health, why and when, what they do afterward, and how much they trust AI compared with other sources. Methods: This two-stage cross-sectional survey employed a commercial web panel (October-November 2026). A screening survey of adults aged [≥]20 years (10,000 responses; 8,209 analyzed) estimated prevalence. A main survey of users (1,000 responses; 735 analyzed) asked about purposes, the most recent use and subsequent actions, and trust in seven information sources. Responses were weighted by sex and age. Results: In the past 6 months, 40.3% of adults (95% confidence interval, 39.3-41.4) asked conversational AI about health. The most recent use occurred before a medical visit for 39.0%, after a visit for 23.4%, and when no visit was being considered for 37.6%. Subsequently, 35.4% visited a medical facility; 12.8% (10.3-15.3) decided not to visit or postponed a visit (5.1% of all adults). Forgoing or delaying was more frequent among users with high trust in AI (trusting it completely or a lot; 22.5% vs. 10.9% among others). Among pre-visit users, it was less frequent with high trust in health professionals (16.7% vs. 30.9%) and did not clearly differ by trust in AI. Of users, 61.4% had high trust in health professionals and 14.3% in AI. Conclusions: In Japan, approximately 4 in 10 adults asked AI about health, and 1 in 8 users forwent or delayed a visit. This was more common with high trust in AI; among pre-visit users, it was associated with low trust in health professionals. How trust in AI and health professionals relates to care seeking warrants further study.
zh_abstract: 【引言】人们越来越多地向对话式人工智能（AI）询问健康问题；然而，在全民健康保险使就医便利的日本，这与就医行为之间有何关系尚不清楚。本研究描述了有多少成年人就健康问题询问AI、原因和时机、之后采取了什么行动，以及与其他信息来源相比他们对AI的信任程度。【方法】这项两阶段横断面调查采用商业网络样本库（2026年10月至11月）。一项针对≥20岁成年人的筛查调查（10,000份回复；分析8,209份）用于估计使用率。一项针对使用者的主调查（1,000份回复；分析735份）询问了使用目的、最近一次使用及随后的行动，以及对七种信息来源的信任。回复按性别和年龄加权。【结果】在过去6个月内，40.3%的成年人（95%置信区间，39.3-41.4）就健康问题询问过对话式AI。最近一次使用发生在就诊前的占39.0%，就诊后的占23.4%，未考虑就诊时的占37.6%。随后，35.4%前往医疗机构就诊；12.8%（10.3-15.3）决定不就诊或推迟就诊（占全部成年人的5.1%）。在对AI高度信任（完全信任或非常信任）的使用者中，放弃或推迟就诊更为常见（22.5%，其他人为10.9%）。在就诊前使用者中，对医务人员高度信任者放弃或推迟就诊的情况较少（16.7% 对 30.9%），而是否对AI高度信任则无明显差异。在使用者中，61.4%对医务人员高度信任，14.3%对AI高度信任。【结论】在日本，约十分之四的成年人就健康问题询问过AI，八分之一的使用者放弃或推迟了就诊。这在对AI高度信任者中更常见；在就诊前使用者中，则与对医务人员的低信任相关。对AI和医务人员的信任与就医行为之间的关系值得进一步研究。

title: Integrating CRISPRi perturbation responses and transcription-factor binding priors for regulatory network inference in triple-negative breast cancer

summary: 提出干预式网络推断框架，整合Perturb-seq单细胞数据与ChIP-seq转录因子结合先验，用于TNBC增强子调控网络推断。
key_points: 使用95,678个细胞的Perturb-seq数据
整合ENCODE转录因子结合先验

abstract: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) represents an aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks actionable cell-surface receptors, restricting frontline systemic management to cytotoxic chemotherapy. While recent functional epigenomics shows that TNBC progression is governed by non-coding regulatory remodeling at distal super-enhancers, conventional Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference methods rely on observational transcriptomic co-expression, which suffers from technical dropouts and confounding correlations that inflate false discoveries (>30%). Here, we present an interventional network inference framework that integrates large-scale single-cell CRISPR-interference perturbation sequencing (Perturb-seq; GSE224986, 95,678 cells across 11,975 sgRNAs) with ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq physical transcription factor binding priors across 819 somatic mutation-associated enhancer loci in human TNBC (MDA-MB-231). Our pipeline reconstructed a tripartite network yielding 5,935 physical TF-enhancer edges, 383,757 functional enhancer-gene edges, and 542,760 unique TF-target gene functional pairs across 372 active enhancers. Topological centrality prioritized master transcriptional drivers governing TNBC oncogenic signaling, including CTCF, POLR2A, EP300, JUND, MYC, and FOS, which regulate Hallmark programs for Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (p = 1.2 x 10-9) and cell cycle progression. Explainable machine learning (SHAP TreeExplainer) revealed non-linear, thresholded transactivation dynamics for AP-1 and MYC. Quantitative benchmarking against held-out CRISPRi ground truth demonstrated strong discriminatory accuracy (AUROC = 0.8999, AUPRC = 0.8745, Precision = 90.13%, FDR = 9.87%), substantially outperforming GENIE3 (AUPRC = 0.6323, FDR = 35.73%) and co-expression correlation (AUPRC = 0.6814). In silico-simulated driver feature silencing correlated with experimental responses (R2 = 0.473, p < 10-122), and master driver signatures significantly stratified overall survival in the METABRIC (n = 320) and TCGA-BRCA (n = 160; p [≤] 0.019) cohorts. Finally, in silico perturbation modeling indicated that multi-target epigenetic combinations achieved 93% topological disruption of oncogenic regulatory connectivity, nominating prioritized candidate circuits for experimental validation.
zh_abstract: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种侵袭性乳腺癌亚型，缺乏可用于干预的细胞表面受体，因此一线全身治疗仅限于细胞毒性化疗。尽管近期功能表观基因组学研究表明，TNBC的进展受远端超级增强子处非编码调控重塑的支配，但传统的基因调控网络（GRN）推断方法依赖观察性转录组共表达，易受技术性缺失（dropout）和混杂相关性的影响，导致假发现增多（>30%）。在此，我们提出一种干预式网络推断框架，将大规模单细胞CRISPR干扰扰动测序（Perturb-seq；GSE224986，11,975个sgRNA、95,678个细胞）与ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq转录因子物理结合先验整合，涵盖人TNBC（MDA-MB-231）中819个与体细胞突变相关的增强子位点。我们的流程重建了一个三方网络，包含5,935条TF-增强子物理边、383,757条增强子-基因功能边，以及跨372个活跃增强子的542,760个独特TF-靶基因功能对。拓扑中心性分析优先筛选出调控TNBC致癌信号的主转录驱动因子，包括CTCF、POLR2A、EP300、JUND、MYC和FOS，它们调控上皮-间质转化（p = 1.2 x 10-9）和细胞周期进程的Hallmark程序。可解释机器学习（SHAP TreeExplainer）揭示了AP-1和MYC的非线性、阈值性转录激活动态。针对留出的CRISPRi真值进行的定量基准测试显示出很强的判别准确性（AUROC = 0.8999，AUPRC = 0.8745，精确度 = 90.13%，FDR = 9.87%），显著优于GENIE3（AUPRC = 0.6323，FDR = 35.73%）和共表达相关性方法（AUPRC = 0.6814）。计算机模拟的驱动因子特征沉默与实验响应相关（R2 = 0.473，p < 10-122），且主驱动因子特征可显著区分METABRIC（n = 320）和TCGA-BRCA（n = 160；p [≤] 0.019）队列的总生存期。最后，计算机扰动建模表明，多靶点表观遗传组合可使致癌调控连接性的拓扑破坏达到93%，从而提名了可供实验验证的优先候选回路。

title: How predictable is an individual's DNA methylation?
zh_title: 个体DNA甲基化的可预测性：差异位点预测新任务
summary: 提出在个体间差异位点预测目标个体DNA甲基化类别的新挑战，指出整体准确率无法反映个体差异预测能力。
key_points: 任务：预测未甲基化/中间/甲基化三类
输入含参考基因组与同类型他人数据，不含基因型
分别评估低变异与高变异位点
reason: 预印本，新任务设定有意义但证据信息有限，属增量档
abstract: DNA methylation is largely shared among individuals of the same cell type, yet at specific genomic sites it differs substantially between individuals. Methods that predict methylation are usually evaluated by their accuracy over all sites. Because methylation at most sites is shared, this accuracy cannot show whether a method predicts an individual's methylation where individuals differ. We present individual-level methylation prediction at sites where individuals differ as a new challenge. Given the reference genome sequence, the methylation of other individuals of the same cell type, and measurements at some sites of a target individual, but not the individual's genotype, the task is to predict the target individual's methylation class (unmethylated, intermediate, or methylated) at the remaining sites. We evaluate predictions separately at sites with low and high variation across individuals. We compare four approaches: the average of other individuals, a sequence model (the DNA language model Nucleotide Transformer) fine-tuned on other individuals' methylation, the same model further fine-tuned on the target individual's measurements, and a local class-average approach using the target individual's nearby training-site class labels. Across 32 individuals from six human cell types, the average of other individuals matched or slightly exceeded both sequence models at sites with low variation among individuals. At the most variable sites, the average of other individuals performed worse than a random predictor that assigns classes at the observed class frequencies, whereas both sequence models performed substantially better than the average. Both sequence models also achieved higher mean weighted F1 than the local class-average approach. Fine-tuning on the target individual's measurements improved predictions more inside regions where other individuals show bimodal methylation (a mix of methylated and unmethylated DNA molecules within one sample) than outside them. Among the most variable sites, it also improved predictions at CpG islands for 25 of the 32 individuals. We conclude that individual-level methylation prediction is a distinct problem that is particularly challenging at sites where individuals differ, and that the benefit of an individual's own measurements is concentrated in genomic contexts identifiable from other individuals' methylation and genomic annotations.
zh_abstract: 同一细胞类型的个体之间，DNA 甲基化在很大程度上是共有的，但在特定基因组位点上个体间差异显著。预测甲基化的方法通常以其在所有位点上的准确性来评估。由于大多数位点的甲基化是共有的，这种准确性无法说明某方法能否在个体间存在差异的位点预测个体的甲基化。我们提出一项新的挑战：在个体间存在差异的位点进行个体水平的甲基化预测。给定参考基因组序列、同一细胞类型其他个体的甲基化，以及目标个体在部分位点的测量值（但不含该个体的基因型），任务是预测目标个体在其余位点的甲基化类别（未甲基化、中间或甲基化）。我们分别在个体间变异低和高的位点评估预测。我们比较了四种方法：其他个体的平均值；基于其他个体甲基化微调的序列模型（DNA 语言模型 Nucleotide Transformer）；在目标个体测量值上进一步微调的同一模型；以及使用目标个体邻近训练位点类别标签的局部类别平均方法。在来自六种人类细胞类型的 32 名个体中，在个体间变异低的位点，其他个体的平均值与两种序列模型相当或略优。在变异最大的位点，其他个体的平均值表现比按观察到的类别频率分配类别的随机预测器更差，而两种序列模型均显著优于该平均值。两种序列模型的平均加权 F1 也均高于局部类别平均方法。在其他个体呈现双峰甲基化（同一样本中甲基化与未甲基化 DNA 分子混合）的区域内，基于目标个体测量值的微调对预测的改善大于区域外。在变异最大的位点中，该微调还改善了 32 名个体中 25 名个体在 CpG 岛的预测。我们得出结论：个体水平的甲基化预测是一个独特的问题，在个体间存在差异的位点尤其具有挑战性，且个体自身测量值的获益集中于可通过其他个体的甲基化和基因组注释识别的基因组背景中。

title: Dependence-Aware Conformal Prediction for 3D Uncertainty Quantification in Molecular Docking

summary: 提出基于GNN与Copula联合校准的共形预测框架，为分子对接的3D结合构象构建紧凑且覆盖可靠的预测区域。

abstract: Molecular docking plays a critical role in drug discovery by predicting three-dimensional (3D) binding poses of small molecules within proteins. However, docking predictions can contain substantial positional errors, making reliable uncertainty quantification essential. Conformal prediction (CP) provides a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, yet constructing compact 3D prediction regions with reliable joint coverage remains challenging due to heterogeneous atomic errors, dependence among spatial coordinates, and distribution shifts. We develop a dependence-aware CP framework for molecular docking that leverages a shared graph neural network (GNN) to estimate adaptive, asymmetric uncertainty intervals using local atomic and global molecular information. Copula-based joint calibration accounts for dependence among coordinate-wise nonconformity scores to construct compact 3D prediction boxes. We further introduce density ratio estimation (DRE) to adapt calibration under distribution shift. Experiments across three docking methods demonstrate that our approach reduces median prediction-box volumes by 37.40%, 95.00%, and 39.16% for AutoDock Vina, Protenix, and MedusaGraph, respectively, compared with a state-of-the-art CP baseline, while achieving empirical joint coverage close to the 90% target. Under the Molecular Group Split and controlled distribution shifts, DRE further reduces coverage deviations, highlighting the potential of dependence-aware and shift-adaptive calibration for reliable 3D molecular docking uncertainty quantification.
zh_abstract: 分子对接通过预测小分子在蛋白质内的三维（3D）结合构象，在药物发现中发挥关键作用。然而，对接预测可能含有较大的位置误差，因此可靠的不确定性量化至关重要。保形预测（conformal prediction，CP）为不确定性量化提供了有原则的框架，但由于原子误差的异质性、空间坐标之间的相关性以及分布偏移，构建具有可靠联合覆盖率的紧凑 3D 预测区域仍具挑战。我们为分子对接开发了一种考虑依赖性的 CP 框架，利用共享图神经网络（GNN），结合局部原子信息和全局分子信息估计自适应、非对称的不确定性区间。基于 Copula 的联合校准考虑了各坐标方向非一致性得分之间的依赖关系，以构建紧凑的 3D 预测盒。我们还引入密度比估计（DRE），使校准适应分布偏移。在三种对接方法上的实验表明，与最先进的 CP 基线相比，我们的方法使 AutoDock Vina、Protenix 和 MedusaGraph 的预测盒体积中位数分别减少 37.40%、95.00% 和 39.16%，同时经验联合覆盖率接近 90% 的目标。在分子分组划分（Molecular Group Split）和受控分布偏移下，DRE 进一步减小了覆盖率偏差，凸显了考虑依赖性且适应偏移的校准在可靠的 3D 分子对接不确定性量化中的潜力。

title: Machine learning prediction of antimicrobial resistance in respiratory metagenomes
zh_title: 呼吸道宏基因组中抗菌药物耐药性的机器学习预测

【背景】对于疑似呼吸道感染的患者，靶向治疗传统上需要先进行细菌培养，再进行表型抗菌药物敏感性试验（AST），这一过程可能长达5天。在急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）中，由于患者病情危重且常接受广谱经验性抗生素治疗，病原体及其耐药谱鉴定的延迟可能尤其有害。抗菌药物耐药（AMR）负担的不断加重减少了有效治疗选择，并增加了初始治疗不充分的风险，使临床决策进一步复杂化。无需培养、由人工智能驱动的计算宏基因组学策略有可能大幅缩短这一时间窗，从而更快地开出靶向治疗处方。为证明此类方法的可行性，我们基于临床宏基因组学构建了一个概念验证框架。

title: Automated Approaches to Extracting Arm-Level Numerical Results From Published Studies for Meta-Analysis.
zh_title: 自动提取已发表研究分组数值结果用于荟萃分析
summary: 结合R规则解析与ChatGPT，从两臂RCT的PDF中提取二分类结局的事件数与入组数，并通过复现Cochrane荟萃分析评估。

LLM仅用于结构化选定句中的数字

abstract: [Campbell systematic reviews] Systematic reviews depend on accurate extraction of outcome data from primary studies, yet this step remains largely manual and time-consuming. Automation tools exist for identifying and retrieving studies and for extracting non-numeric study characteristics, but few target the numerical arm-level results needed for meta-analysis. We developed and evaluated a hybrid approach for extracting arm-level results (number of events and number enrolled per arm) for binary outcomes from two-arm randomized controlled trials published as PDFs. Rule-based string processing in R locates and parses results tables and candidate sentences in the Results section; a large language model (ChatGPT, accessed through the OpenAI API) is then used only to structure the numerical information in the selected sentences. We evaluated the approach by replicating a Cochrane meta-analysis of favipiravir for COVID-19 (11 trials; all-cause mortality at 28 to 30 days). Table-based extraction was applied to five articles and in-line text extraction to six. The extracted data matched the published arm-level results for all studies except one, where the pipeline recovered a sample size (24) consistent with the trial's results table rather than its text (25). The replicated random-effects meta-analysis gave a summary risk ratio of 0.84 (95% CI 0.49-1.46), identical to the original review, with minor differences in study weights attributable to rounding. An independent test on infectious bovine keratoconjunctivitis vaccine trials showed partial transferability, with failures confined to scanned PDFs and complex table structures. The code and the list of extracted articles are publicly available on GitHub.
zh_abstract: [Campbell系统综述] 系统综述依赖于从原始研究中准确提取结局数据，但这一步骤目前仍主要依靠人工，耗时较长。目前已有用于识别和检索研究以及提取非数值型研究特征的自动化工具，但很少有工具针对荟萃分析所需的各组数值型结果。我们开发并评估了一种混合方法，用于从以PDF形式发表的两组随机对照试验中提取二分类结局的各组结果（各组事件数和入组人数）。该方法先在R中通过基于规则的字符串处理，定位并解析结果部分中的结果表格和候选句子；随后仅使用大语言模型（ChatGPT，通过OpenAI API访问）对所选句子中的数值信息进行结构化。我们通过复现一项关于法匹拉韦（favipiravir）治疗COVID-19的Cochrane荟萃分析（11项试验；28至30天全因死亡率）来评估该方法。基于表格的提取应用于5篇文章，正文内文本提取应用于6篇。除一项研究外，所有研究提取的数据均与已发表的各组结果一致；该例中，流程恢复出的样本量（24）与该试验结果表一致，而与其正文中的数字（25）不同。复现的随机效应荟萃分析得到的合并风险比为0.84（95% CI 0.49-1.46），与原综述相同，研究权重的细微差异可归因于四舍五入。对传染性牛角膜结膜炎疫苗试验的独立测试显示该方法具有部分可迁移性，失败仅限于扫描版PDF和复杂的表格结构。代码及所提取文章的清单已在GitHub上公开。

title: Computational Drug Discovery in the Pandemic Era: AI-Enhanced Virtual Screening Approaches and Medical Informatics.
