abstract: [Healthcare informatics research] This narrative review examines how artificial intelligence-enhanced virtual screening (AI-VS), including multitarget screening strategies and hybrid AI-docking workflows, and the integration of medical informatics advance antiviral drug discovery and pandemic preparedness. We reviewed recent studies that used graph neural networks to predict binding affinity, molecular dynamics simulations to validate binding stability, absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) profiling frameworks, and protein structure prediction tools, including AlphaFold2 (2021) and AlphaFold3 (2024). A nonsystematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar identified seven representative studies published between 2020 and 2026, which were selected for their relevance, methodological innovation, and clinical applicability. Molecular dynamics simulations validated binding stability, while multi-target screening identified natural product inhibitors with favorable ADMET profiles. The hybrid AI-docking platform outperformed traditional docking, with VirtuDockDL achieving 99% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.99 on benchmark datasets, although external validation across protein families remains limited. These values apply to the benchmark dataset used and should not be generalized to other protein families, antiviral targets, or real-world drug discovery settings. AI-VS has the potential to shorten computational screening timelines from years to weeks and provide scalable frameworks that may support pandemic preparedness; this acceleration concerns in silico screening, not the full experimental or clinical development process. These methods illustrate how computational-first approaches can accelerate early therapeutic discovery, although they did not directly lead to the approval of nirmatrelvir or molnupiravir. Future priorities include expanding chemical probe libraries, improving the precision of scoring functions, and integrating AI-VS with medical informatics infrastructure.
zh_abstract: 【医疗信息学研究】本叙述性综述探讨人工智能增强的虚拟筛选（AI-VS，包括多靶点筛选策略和AI-对接混合工作流）以及医学信息学的整合如何推进抗病毒药物发现和大流行防范。我们回顾了近期研究，这些研究使用图神经网络预测结合亲和力、分子动力学模拟验证结合稳定性、吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）评估框架，以及蛋白质结构预测工具，包括AlphaFold2（2021）和AlphaFold3（2024）。通过对PubMed、Scopus和Google Scholar的非系统性检索，识别出2020年至2026年间发表的七项代表性研究，其入选依据为相关性、方法创新性和临床适用性。分子动力学模拟验证了结合稳定性，而多靶点筛选识别出具有良好ADMET特征的天然产物抑制剂。AI-对接混合平台优于传统对接，其中VirtuDockDL在基准数据集上达到99%的准确率和0.99的受试者工作特征曲线下面积，但跨蛋白家族的外部验证仍然有限。这些数值仅适用于所用的基准数据集，不应推广到其他蛋白家族、抗病毒靶点或真实世界的药物发现场景。AI-VS有潜力将计算筛选时间从数年缩短至数周，并提供可能支持大流行防范的可扩展框架；这种加速仅涉及计算机模拟筛选，而非完整的实验或临床开发过程。这些方法说明了计算优先的方法如何加速早期治疗药物的发现，尽管它们并未直接促成nirmatrelvir或molnupiravir的获批。未来的重点包括扩充化学探针库、提高评分函数的精确度，以及将AI-VS与医学信息学基础设施相整合。

title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning of Latent Patient Representations from Multi-Institutional EHRs

abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) contain rich health information for uncovering latent patient representations and clinically meaningful subgroups. Learning from EHR data across institutions is valuable because representations learned at a single site may reflect local data patterns and lack generalizability, yet pooling patient-level records across institutions is often impractical because of privacy constraints and communication costs. We propose a communication-efficient, non-iterative federated spectral method for learning shared latent representation components from multi-institutional EHRs, in which each institution shares aggregate marginal frequencies and a low-rank spectral summary while keeping patient-level records local. A central server aggregates these summaries with the pooled marginal frequencies to recover both the shared low-rank structure and the canonical row-normalization direction required for interpretable representation recovery. We prove row-wise recovery guarantees and error bounds, with a leading federated variance term matching a corresponding lower bound under explicit regularity conditions. Simulations show that our method closely matches pooled analysis in estimating latent representation components, improves as more sites contribute summaries, and outperforms single-site and existing federated benchmarks across a range of data settings. Applied to real-world multi-facility EHR data for stroke patients, the method learns interpretable patient representations that highlight clinically distinct subgroups and could help inform subgroup-specific care.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）蕴含丰富的健康信息，可用于挖掘潜在的患者表征及具有临床意义的亚组。跨机构学习EHR数据具有重要价值，因为单一机构学习到的表征可能反映当地的数据模式而缺乏可推广性；然而，由于隐私限制和通信成本，将各机构的患者层面记录汇集在一起往往不可行。我们提出了一种通信高效、非迭代的联邦谱方法，用于从多机构EHR中学习共享的潜在表征成分：各机构仅共享汇总的边际频率和低秩谱摘要，患者层面记录保留在本地。中央服务器将这些摘要与汇总后的边际频率进行聚合，以恢复共享的低秩结构，以及可解释表征恢复所需的规范行归一化方向。我们证明了逐行恢复保证和误差界，并且在明确的正则性条件下，其联邦方差主导项与相应的下界相匹配。模拟结果表明，在估计潜在表征成分方面，我们的方法与汇总分析（pooled analysis）高度接近，随着更多机构贡献摘要而不断改善，并在各种数据设置下优于单机构方法和现有联邦基准方法。应用于卒中患者的真实世界多机构EHR数据时，该方法学习到可解释的患者表征，突出了临床上有区别的亚组，并可能有助于为针对亚组的诊疗提供参考。

title: Feasibility of Multifrequency Neural Network-Based Wave Inversion in Ultrasound Time-Harmonic Elastography

summary: 探讨将MRE中基于物理合成数据训练的多频神经网络波重建方法MF-ElastoNet用于超声时谐弹性成像，以应对散斑噪声与稀疏覆盖问题。
key_points: 超声THE可全视野测量组织硬度
深度学习在THE中尚未被探索
沿用合成物理波数据训练的MF-ElastoNet

abstract: Ultrasound time-harmonic elastography (THE) is a non-invasive imaging technique that measures soft-tissue stiffness. Relying on the same principle of time-harmonic shear wave excitation as established magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), THE offers full field-of-view stiffness mapping at short acquisition times and sub-second temporal resolution across organs. However, reconstruction of shear wave speed maps from acquired tissue wavefields remains challenging due to speckle noise and sparse spatial coverage of the lateral component. Deep learning methods have shown promising results for image reconstruction in transient-based ultrasound elastography modalities but remain unexplored in THE. In MRE, MF-ElastoNet, a 2D multifrequency neural network-based wave reconstruction method trained on synthetic physics-based wave data, has shown high generalizability across dynamic ranges and resolutions. We investigated the potential of a multifrequency neural network-based wave inversion for THE, by performing a first feasibility analysis. To this end, we adapted the processing pipeline of MF-ElastoNet from MRE to THE. We tested our approach on THE acquired phantom data from the algorithms for mapping elastic modulus Challenge, as well as on in vivo liver THE in 4 healthy volunteers and 14 patients with focal liver lesions, including benign focal nodular hyperplasia, and malignant hepatocellular carcinoma and adenocarcinoma. MF-ElastoNet was successfully adapted to THE with in vivo liver testing. Compared with k-MDEV, the state-of-the-art wave inversion method for THE, Bland-Altman analysis showed a mean bias of -0.02 m/s (95% limits of agreement: -0.36 to 0.33 m/s).
zh_abstract: 超声时间谐波弹性成像（time-harmonic elastography，THE）是一种测量软组织硬度的无创成像技术。THE 与成熟的磁共振弹性成像（MRE）基于相同的时间谐波剪切波激励原理，可在较短采集时间内实现全视野硬度成像，并在各器官中具有亚秒级时间分辨率。然而，由于散斑噪声以及横向分量空间覆盖稀疏，从采集到的组织波场重建剪切波速度图仍然具有挑战性。深度学习方法在基于瞬态的超声弹性成像模式的图像重建中已显示出良好前景，但在 THE 中尚未被探索。在 MRE 中，MF-ElastoNet 是一种基于二维多频神经网络的波重建方法，使用基于物理的合成波数据训练，已在不同动态范围和分辨率下表现出较高的泛化能力。我们通过首次可行性分析，探讨了基于多频神经网络的波反演在 THE 中的潜力。为此，我们将 MF-ElastoNet 的处理流程由 MRE 调整适配至 THE。我们在来自弹性模量映射算法挑战赛（algorithms for mapping elastic modulus Challenge）的 THE 采集体模数据上，以及在 4 名健康志愿者和 14 名局灶性肝病变患者（包括良性局灶性结节增生，以及恶性肝细胞癌和腺癌）的在体肝脏 THE 上测试了我们的方法。MF-ElastoNet 已成功适配于 THE，并通过在体肝脏测试得到验证。与 THE 的最先进波反演方法 k-MDEV 相比，Bland-Altman 分析显示平均偏差为 -0.02 m/s（95% 一致性界限：-0.36 至 0.33 m/s）。

title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
zh_title: 多层边缘分诊：为安全临床智能体优化延迟
summary: 提出多层边缘分诊安全筛查架构：本地小型分类器就地处理明确查询，仅将模糊查询升级至云端LLM裁判，以降低延迟。

仅模糊查询转发至云端 LLM 裁判
覆盖PHI、执业范围、阅读理解等策略

abstract: Deploying generative AI agents in enterprise clinical workflows requires enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies--preventing HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) exposure, maintaining clinical scope-of-practice boundaries, ensuring patient-appropriate reading comprehension, and preserving brand integrity--under interactive latency constraints. Synchronous outbound calls to cloud Large Language Model (LLM) judges add substantial network and decoding overhead onto the critical response path. We present Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 sequence classifier on the clinical agent's host server, resolving clear queries in-process without a network round-trip and escalating only ambiguous queries to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge. To evaluate Tier-1 encoders without length or unigram shortcuts, we construct four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks seeded from MedSafetyBench, ASQ-PHI, and a synthetic four-mandate clinical assistant policy (Generic HealthCorp). While frozen local encoders match cloud models on structured PHI detection (>= 98.3% accuracy in 14x faster than cloud LLM evaluation on our benchmark host). Per-policy error analysis reveals ceiling local recall on PHI (100.0%), brand (100.0%), and clinical scope (98.7%-99.3%) violations, isolating residual errors to reading-level checks (93.3%-95.3%) and motivating targeted multi-tier escalation.
zh_abstract: 在企业临床工作流程中部署生成式AI智能体，需要在交互式延迟约束下执行多维度的安全与合规策略——防止泄露HIPAA受保护健康信息（PHI）、保持临床执业范围边界、确保适合患者的阅读理解水平，以及维护品牌完整性。对云端大语言模型（LLM）评判器的同步外呼会在关键响应路径上增加大量网络和解码开销。我们提出多层边缘分诊（Multi-Tier Edge Triage）这一安全筛查架构，将一个紧凑的第一层序列分类器与临床智能体共置于其宿主服务器上，在进程内直接处理明确的查询而无需网络往返，仅将模糊查询升级至第二层云端LLM评判器。为在不存在长度或单字（unigram）捷径的情况下评估第一层编码器，我们构建了四个长度匹配的对比孪生基准，其来源为MedSafetyBench、ASQ-PHI以及一个合成的四项要求的临床助手策略（Generic HealthCorp）。冻结的本地编码器在结构化PHI检测上与云端模型相当（准确率 >= 98.3%，在我们的基准主机上比云端LLM评估快14倍）。逐策略错误分析显示，本地召回率在PHI（100.0%）、品牌（100.0%）和临床范围（98.7%-99.3%）违规上达到上限，残余错误集中于阅读水平检查（93.3%-95.3%），从而促使采用有针对性的多层升级机制。

abstract: Data scarcity and quality issues remain significant barriers to developing robust predictive models in medical research. Traditional reliance on real-world data often leads to biased models with poor generalizability across diverse patient populations. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising solution, yet challenges related to these samples' representativeness and effective utilization persist. This paper introduces Profile2Gen, a novel data-centric framework designed to guide the generation and refinement of synthetic data, focusing on addressing hard-to-learn samples in regression tasks. We conducted approximately 18,000 experiments to validate its effectiveness across six medical datasets, utilizing seven state-of-the-art generative models. Results demonstrate that refined synthetic samples can reduce predictive errors and enhance model reliability. Additionally, we generalize the DataIQ framework to support regression tasks, enabling its application in broader contexts. Statistical analyses confirm that our approach achieves equal or superior performance compared to models trained exclusively on real data.
zh_abstract: 数据稀缺和数据质量问题仍然是医学研究中构建稳健预测模型的主要障碍。传统上依赖真实世界数据，往往会导致模型存在偏倚，并且在不同患者群体中的泛化能力较差。合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的解决方案，但这些样本的代表性及其有效利用方面的挑战依然存在。本文提出 Profile2Gen，这是一种新型的以数据为中心的框架，旨在指导合成数据的生成与优化，重点解决回归任务中难以学习的样本。我们开展了约 18,000 次实验，利用七种最先进的生成模型，在六个医学数据集上验证其有效性。结果表明，经过优化的合成样本可降低预测误差并提高模型可靠性。此外，我们将 DataIQ 框架推广至支持回归任务，使其能够应用于更广泛的场景。统计分析证实，与仅使用真实数据训练的模型相比，我们的方法取得了相当或更优的性能。

summary: 对一所中国医学院13名医学生进行半结构化访谈，探讨其对AI在临床培训中作用及教师指导期望的看法。

abstract: [Perspectives on medical education] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming clinical practice, yet its integration into medical education remains largely unstructured. In China, where AI adoption is accelerating, little is known about how medical students perceive AI's role or what guidance they expect from educators. This study explores Chinese medical students' perspectives on AI in clinical training and their preferences for faculty engagement. Using educational cultural hegemony as a theoretical framework, the research team conducted in-depth, semi-structured interviews with 13 medical students across all five years of training at a medical school in China. Interviews addressed three sensitizing scenarios involving AI for clinical documentation, diagnostic assistance, and learning support. Transcripts were analyzed using Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis. Four themes were identified: Learning in the Shadows describes how students use AI covertly due to uncertain policies; Trust but Verify captures students' nuanced stance on AI reliability; The Human Element reveals concerns that AI may erode clinical reasoning and patient-physician relationships within China's high-volume healthcare system; and Educator as Compass describes students' desire for faculty who proactively teach AI literacy and model appropriate use. Chinese medical students navigate AI use without formal guidance in an ambiguous space between enthusiasm and caution. They seek educators who acknowledge AI's presence and preserve humanistic medicine. Findings underscore the urgent need for curricular integration of AI literacy and faculty development, particularly within hierarchical educational contexts. These findings carry implications beyond China's borders, suggesting that when institutions fail to acknowledge emerging technologies, students adapt independently but not necessarily safely or equitably.
zh_abstract: [医学教育视角] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变临床实践，但其融入医学教育的过程在很大程度上仍缺乏结构。在 AI 应用不断加速的中国，对于医学生如何看待 AI 的角色，以及他们期望教育者提供何种指导，我们所知甚少。本研究探讨中国医学生对临床培训中 AI 的看法及其对教师参与的偏好。研究团队以教育文化霸权为理论框架，对中国一所医学院校涵盖全部五个培养年级的 13 名医学生进行了深入的半结构化访谈。访谈涉及三个启发性情景：用于临床文书的 AI、用于诊断辅助的 AI 和用于学习支持的 AI。访谈记录采用 Braun 和 Clarke 的反思性主题分析法进行分析。共识别出四个主题：“在阴影中学习”描述了由于政策不明确，学生秘密使用 AI；“信任但要验证”反映了学生对 AI 可靠性的微妙立场；“人的因素”揭示了人们担心在中国高负荷的医疗体系中，AI 可能削弱临床推理及医患关系；“作为指南针的教育者”描述了学生希望教师主动教授 AI 素养并示范恰当使用。中国医学生在缺乏正式指导的情况下使用 AI，处于热情与谨慎之间的模糊空间。他们期望教育者承认 AI 的存在并守护人文医学。研究结果强调，特别是在等级化的教育环境中，迫切需要将 AI 素养纳入课程并开展教师发展。这些发现的意义超出中国范围，提示当机构未能正视新兴技术时，学生会自行适应，但未必安全或公平。

abstract: Introduction: Long COVID (LC) remains a global public-health challenge, affecting an estimated 10-30% of COVID-19-survivors. Machine learning (ML) can help identify molecular features associated with LC. Human ion channels (HICs), that regulate immune-cell signaling and cellular homeostasis, may contribute to LC-associated processes and offer insights into relevant pathways and potential drug-repurposing candidates. Methodology: RNA-seq data from COVID-19-recovered and LC patients across six datasets were integrated, preprocessed, and corrected for batch effects. Supervised ML models were evaluated using leave-one-batch-out validation, with SHAP identifying features across validation folds. Functional enrichment, host-host and host-viral protein-protein interaction analyses were performed, followed by drug interaction analysis of potential HICs within the resulting interactome. Results: A support vector classifier with an RBF kernel achieved a mean-AUC of 0.664 across six validation folds. SHAP analysis of the three selected folds (AUC = 0.722, 0.836, and 0.817) identified 225, 153, and 241 genes, respectively. Functional enrichment highlighted pathways including histidine metabolism and TNF signaling. Among the 613 genes identified across these folds, 9 were HICs and 39 were immune signaling-related genes (ISGs), whose protein-protein interaction analysis revealed a pharmacologically relevant interactome. Furthermore, four HICs including CLCN3, KCNQ3, RYR1, and ZACN interacted with 30 approved drugs. Conclusion: ML-based analysis of integrated RNA-seq data identified HICs and ISGs associated with LC, while functional enrichment and PPI analyses provided insights into their potential biological relevance. Drug interaction analysis further highlighted candidate HIC-targeting drugs for future investigation in LC management. This computational framework provides preliminary, hypothesis-generating insights to guide future research.

abstract: Background: Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), frailty, and fall risk often co-occur in older adults and share motor signs, yet they are screened and modeled separately. A unified model that predicts all 3 conditions from 1 sensor-based assessment could support earlier and more efficient screening, but such a model has rarely been developed or rigorously compared with separate models. Objective: This study aimed to develop a unified machine learning model that predicts MCI, frailty, and fall risk together from sensor-based motor-function data, compare it with separate single-label models, explain its predictions, and test its robustness. Methods: Community-dwelling older adults (n=79) completed a multimodal motor-function assessment with the Mizzou Point-of-Care Assessment System (MPASS), covering gait, sit-to-stand, static balance, step-down, and reaction time, with some tasks repeated under a dual-task condition. With demographic and family-history data, this yielded 59 features. Unified classifier-chain and single-label models were built with 5 algorithms across 6 modeling stages, evaluated with repeated nested cross-validation, and compared using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and paired bootstrap tests. The final model was explained with Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), and its robustness and the sufficiency of the sample size were tested with chain-input, chain-order sensitivity, domain-ablation, learning-curve, and power analyses. 【背景】轻度认知障碍（MCI）、衰弱和跌倒风险常在老年人中同时存在，并具有共同的运动体征，但目前它们仍被分别筛查和建模。一个能通过一次基于传感器的评估同时预测这3种状况的统一模型，可能有助于更早、更高效的筛查，但这类模型很少被开发，也很少与分别建立的模型进行严格比较。
【目的】本研究旨在基于传感器运动功能数据，开发一个同时预测MCI、衰弱和跌倒风险的统一机器学习模型，将其与分别建立的单标签模型比较，解释其预测结果，并检验其稳健性。
【方法】社区居住的老年人（n=79）使用Mizzou即时评估系统（Mizzou Point-of-Care Assessment System，MPASS）完成多模态运动功能评估，涵盖步态、坐站转换、静态平衡、下台阶和反应时间，其中部分任务在双任务条件下重复进行。结合人口学和家族史数据，共得到59个特征。采用5种算法、在6个建模阶段构建统一的分类器链模型和单标签模型，通过重复嵌套交叉验证进行评估，并使用受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和配对bootstrap检验进行比较。最终模型采用Shapley加性解释（SHAP）进行解释，并通过链输入、链顺序敏感性、领域消融、学习曲线和检验效能分析来检验其稳健性及样本量是否充足。
【结果】在采用类别加权时，统一模型在20种配置中的17种里平均AUC高于单标签模型，且从未显著更差；在嵌套模型选择下其表现至少与单标签模型相当（0.615 vs 0.605；P=.58）。最终的极端随机树（extra trees）模型平均AUC为0.645（95% CI 0.569-0.722）；对MCI的区分能力最佳（AUC 0.779，95% CI 0.680-0.872），对衰弱（0.606）和跌倒风险（0.551）较低。该模型对3种结局均高估了风险，其中衰弱最为明显。大多数特征（43/59，73%）为3种状况所共享，其中以步幅最为突出，且训练组与测试组参与者的SHAP排序一致（{rho}=0.99）。预测的衰弱是跌倒风险最重要的输入，仅用45个传感器特征的表现与完整模型相当。学习曲线提示，跌倒风险预测将受益于更多参与者。
【结论】一个统一模型能够通过一次基于传感器的评估同时预测MCI、衰弱和跌倒风险（原文至此截断：“…from one sensor-based ass”）。

abstract: Background: Molecular changes in peripheral tissues may provide insights into cognitive aging, but identifying relevant genes without using behavioral outcomes for feature selection remains challenging. Results: We applied tensor decomposition-based unsupervised feature extraction to publicly available hippocampal and colonic transcriptomic and promoter DNA methylation profiles from mice across five age groups. A tensor comprising tissue, molecular modality, age group, biological replicate, and gene dimensions was constructed using 16,080 shared genes. Higher-order singular value decomposition identified a component with a monotonic age pattern, shared tissue contributions, and opposing transcriptomic and methylation contributions. This component yielded 1,577 selected genes without using cognitive scores for feature selection. The corresponding colonic methylation score correlated with overall cognition (r=0.589; Benjamini--Hochberg-adjusted P=9.87 x10-7), although no significant associations remained after age adjustment. The selected genes were enriched for enteric neuronal and glial markers derived from a published single-cell atlas, with 5.10-fold and 4.65-fold enrichment, respectively. Comparison with the broadest available Boruta-selected gene set identified only 64 overlapping genes, leaving 1,513 genes selected exclusively by the tensor approach in this comparison. These remaining genes retained significant enrichment for synaptic processes and enteric neuronal and glial signatures using library-specific backgrounds. Conclusions: Unsupervised tensor integration recovered an aging-associated relationship between colonic methylation and cognition while identifying a largely distinct set of functionally coherent candidate genes. These findings complement supervised feature selection and provide candidates for investigating enteric neural involvement in cognitive aging, without establishing an age-independent association or a causal gut-to-brain mechanism.

abstract: [Frontiers in sociology] Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly transforming the communicative processes through which coordinated online manipulation is produced, personalized, and coordinated at unprecedented scale, raising growing concerns about its societal implications. This Mini Review critically examines empirical research published during the first 3 years of widespread public accessibility of GenAI to assess how these developments are reshaping Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior (CIB) across different societal domains. Three interconnected developments consistently emerge: the transformation of communicative production through scalable, personalized, and multimodal content generation; increasing AI-assisted coordination of influence campaigns; and new forms of communicative vulnerability associated with increasingly human-like synthetic communication. Together, these developments suggest that coordinated influence is becoming more adaptive, persistent, and difficult to recognize within evolving human-AI communicative configurations. Beyond synthesizing recent empirical evidence, the review identifies emerging conceptual and methodological challenges concerning communicative agency, coordination, and authenticity, while outlining future directions for sociological research. Overall, the growing use of GenAI in evolving CIB poses significant risks to public trust, opinion formation, and democratic discourse, underscoring the urgency of understanding and addressing this rapidly evolving phenomenon.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in sociology] 生成式人工智能（GenAI）正在迅速改变协同在线操纵的传播过程，使其得以以前所未有的规模被生产、个性化和协调，其社会影响日益引发关注。本迷你综述批判性地审视了GenAI向公众广泛开放后的前3年内发表的实证研究，以评估这些发展如何在不同社会领域重塑协同不真实行为（Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior，CIB）。研究一致呈现出三个相互关联的发展：通过可扩展、个性化和多模态内容生成实现的传播生产的转变；影响力行动中日益增强的人工智能辅助协调；以及与日益类人的合成传播相关的新型传播脆弱性。综合来看，这些发展表明，在不断演变的人机传播配置中，协同影响正变得更具适应性、持久性，也更难以识别。除综合近期实证证据外，本综述还指出了围绕传播能动性、协调与真实性的新兴概念和方法学挑战，并概述了社会学研究的未来方向。总体而言，GenAI在不断演变的CIB中的使用日益增多，对公众信任、意见形成和民主话语构成重大风险，凸显了理解并应对这一快速演变现象的紧迫性。
